_why: THE portal rule (MS19, migration 590), one table read by both languages. A property matches
portal set P when any of its ads is on P (all_sources), active or not; the status switch is
judged on those ads: active = an active ad on P (active_sources), inactive = ads on P and
none of them active; several portals = any of them; no portal = the property's own
is_active. tests/test_portal_rule.py runs `cases` through public.portal_status_matches and
their `any` rows through the Watchdog's compiled clause; queries.test.ts runs them through
applyPortalRule. `broker_cases` are the same rule over ONE broker's ads only (portal and
broker together = one ad): the DB lane seeds the ads and calls the broker lookup, the SPA
aggregates the broker's ads and runs the same rendering.

cases.name: no portal, any: an ended property matches
no portal, active: the property's own is_active
no portal, active: an ended property is out
no portal, inactive: an ended property matches
no portal, inactive: a live property is out
one portal, any: an ad there behind another portal's canonical ad
one portal, any: no ad there
one portal, active: its ad there ended, though the property is live elsewhere
one portal, active: an active ad there
one portal, inactive: ads there, none active, the property live elsewhere
one portal, inactive: an active ad there
one portal, inactive: no ad there at all
several portals, any: an ad on either
several portals, any: no ad on any of them
several portals, active: every ad there ended
several portals, active: an active ad on either
several portals, inactive: one of them still active
several portals, inactive: every ad there ended
a property with no lists matches no portal

broker_cases.name: B on sreality, C on idnes: B + idnes is no ad of B's
B on sreality, C on idnes: C + idnes is C's own ad
B's idnes ad ended, its sreality ad live: B + idnes + active is out
B's idnes ad ended, its sreality ad live: B + idnes + inactive matches
B's idnes ad ended, its sreality ad live: B + active matches
C's live idnes ad does not make B's ended one active
C's live idnes ad: B + idnes + inactive still matches B's ended ad
only C's ad is live: B + inactive (no portal) matches
